description: Agent-authored taskset of 120 tasks: 6 personas x 4 stories x 5 levels (Execute, Find, Derive, Ground, Compose), run closed-world - the agent discovers the workspace through get_workspace_snapshot. Authored from task_templates/ under the task-author skill, reviewed by fresh-context validators and a per-story fairness judge, certified by oracle/no-op replay, and gated on a gpt-4.1-mini calibration staircase (pooled 85/60/36/17/0 over three repeats).
